name: TRUE LOVE'S CURSE
source:
Play as the owner of a magic shop and cast curses that can only be undone by true love's kiss.

Figure out the right combination of words to cast a curse that matches your customer's needs! (Or don't - how you cast your curses is up to you!)

[From [url=https://npckc.itch.io/true-loves-curse]itch.io[/url]]
